name: BUA Full Document Importer
description: Takes a complete JSON representation of a BUA form extracted by the LLM from an uploaded document, validates it, and populates the entire global BUA Data Structure in one batch operation.

inputs.name: full_bua_data
inputs.description: A JSON-formatted string containing the complete extracted BUA data. Must match the schema of the main BUAForm Pydantic model (keys: lab_identity, strains, personnel).

outputs.description: Returns the validation status and the updated global state of the BUA form.

output.message: Full BUA document successfully imported and validated.
